text: Numeric equality PR (#6034) + a related data-loss fix (#6736, new P0 I filed): REPLACE into N/F/B fields stored only 6 significant digits (REPLACE n WITH 123.456789 -> 123.457; 1.0000005 -> 1) because the writer used the display formatter value_as_string. Fixed with a round-trip formatter + rounding to field scale. Other write paths that serialize numbers (INSERT INTO, APPEND FROM, GATHER) are NOT audited for the same truncation: worth a look if you have a slot. Equality: the 0.000001 absolute epsilon is replaced by a ~1 ulp relative tolerance (VFP9 distinguishes 1.0000005 from 1 but treats 0.1+0.2 = 0.3 as equal); VFP also rounds computed results to operand decimals and depends on SET DECIMALS, which Copperfin does not model (documented in the traceability row). #6735 (date function args) and #5924 (MDY/DMY) are queued.
